mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT identity.organization_id, version.organization_version_id, version.parent_organization_id, version.code, version.name, version.org_type AS organization_type, version.status, source_binding.source_org_id AS source_organization_id, version.effective_from, version.effective_to, version.source_authority, version.row_version FROM auth_principal principal JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment assignment ON assignment.principal_id = principal.principal_id JOIN auth_role_capability role_capability ON role_capability.role_id = assignment.role_id JOIN auth_capability capability ON capability.capability_id = role_capability.capability_id AND capability.capability_code = #{capabilityCode} JOIN auth_data_scope data_scope ON data_scope.scope_id = assignment.data_scope_id JOIN organization_identity identity ON ( (data_scope.scope_type = 'LEGAL_ENTITY' AND identity.legal_entity_id = data_scope.legal_entity_id) OR (data_scope.scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND ( identity.organization_id = data_scope.organization_id OR (data_scope.include_descendants = TRUE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_current_closure closure WHERE closure.ancestor_organization_id = data_scope.organization_id AND closure.descendant_organization_id = identity.organization_id )) )) ) JOIN organization_version version ON version.organization_id = identity.organization_id AND version.effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} AND (version.effective_to IS NULL OR version.effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) LEFT JOIN organization_source_binding source_binding ON source_binding.organization_id = identity.organization_id AND source_binding.source_system = 'SEEYON' AND source_binding.effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} AND (source_binding.effective_to IS NULL OR source_binding.effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) WHERE principal.principal_id = #{principalId} AND principal.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( #{includeInactive} = TRUE OR version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND identity.identity_status = 'ACTIVE' ) AND assignment.valid_from <= #{permissionAt} AND (assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR assignment.valid_to > #{permissionAt}) AND data_scope.valid_from <= #{permissionAt} AND (data_scope.valid_to IS NULL OR data_scope.valid_to > #{permissionAt}) ORDER BY version.code, version.name, identity.organization_id
